facts.statement: During the Wilds Condo House Party Tuesday event the team visited around 8 player-decorated Wilds Condos.
facts.quote: we visited around 8 player-decorated Wilds Condos.

article_summaries.title: Fun with the Wilds Condo
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (listed as 'Free Realms - What is New?', posted about two weeks before the 2012-02-19 capture) describing the Wilds Condo, a new starter home for new players that existing players also received. It reports a Wilds Condo special of the House Party Tuesday community event on January 31, 2012, and asks players to email decorated house screenshots to homeshow@soe.sony.com.
